## Three separate milestones

- [ ] **Implemented:** agreed code exists and appropriate checks pass.
- [ ] **Playable:** Quentin personally tested this exact candidate on his iPhone. Preview URL, SHA and observations:
- [ ] **Released:** Quentin explicitly approved publication; public SHA, deployment and player experience were verified. Evidence:

Passing CI alone cannot check Playable or Released. Infrastructure/docs-only PRs should mark player milestones not applicable, not claim a gameplay phase is complete.

## Approval boundaries

- [ ] No merge without Quentin's explicit approval.
- [ ] No preview or production deployment without explicit approval.
- [ ] No force pushes, historical branch deletion or automatic merge.
- [ ] State whether this PR depends on another PR and the intended review order.
